tasks.instruction: Give me two alternative endings for the scene: one that closes on a resigned, intimate Dinu (linger on his face and the key) and one that closes on an ominous, unresolved note (pull back to the environment, emphasize rain/metal sounds and distance between the men). Specify which shots to use, any re-timing or small re-ordering of the existing last clips (S16, S17, S18, S19, S20, S21), the camera sizes/frames to favour, how long to hold each shot, and the sound and lighting cues to sell the emotional finish.
